scope_summary: User-approved recovery and continuation: replace the retired three-front topology with one broad advancing front, expose Domestic/Roulette/Front work surfaces, retain roulette agency, keep buildings in the global 6-plus-stable-Ward-Forward-and-Clash roster only, gate one fixed tower by Ward Forward ownership, and replace the wide primary strategic map with a live battle-primary viewport plus a compact read-only five-sector march minimap. On 2026-08-31 the user locked the exact modular close-battlefield foundation and the exact Lumern/Veil terrain-prop sets, with terrain restricted outside the soldier travel corridor; this approval authorizes their repository copies, the active BattleFocusView binding, and keeping the retired root battlefield renderer hidden and unbound during a run. The same user approval authorizes a boot-to-tutorial TitleScreen with one real expedition action, its native scene/script binding, and an isolated Godot candidate-preview scene. The later explicit visual lock selects only TITLE-WORDMARK-01 and the last attached TITLE-BG-06 battle-surge background for byte-exact canonical copies at assets/art/ui/title/ and TitleScreen binding; all other title candidates and the candidate preview are removed after provenance readback. On 2026-09-02 the user locked the exact Archer/Mage derivatives, separately authorized autonomous production of future required images, and asked the remaining role art to align to that pair. The later instruction that Veil roles read too human authorizes four versioned Veil monster variants (Spear Guard V3, Archer V2, Cavalry V3, Mage V2), their BattleFocus/catalog bindings, true-alpha normalization, and technical runtime QA. Earlier Veil V1/V2 bytes remain preserved provenance; this scope does not claim a new exact per-byte user selection for the four monster variants.
